exposure: type of antenatal health care provider
Type of antenatal health care provider (family physician, obstetrician, midwife, or family physician plus obstetrician)
cohort: 231,697 singleton births at 20-42 weeks' gestation in Ontario, Canada from 2014-2016
finding: Weight gain during pregnancy and rates of associated secondary outcomes (large for gestational age, small for gestational age, cesarean delivery, and preterm birth) did not differ according to antenatal health care provider.
mod_finding: Weight gain during pregnancy and rates of associated secondary outcomes, such as large for gestational age or preterm birth, did not differ according to antenatal health care provider type (family physician, obstetrician, midwife, or family physician plus obstetrician).
